s: a vegan-friendly concept café where you write a letter to your future self
w: A concept café near Gyeongbokgung Palace built around an unusual ritual: write a letter to yourself (or someone else) that the café will post at a future date you choose. Plant-filled, calm, and vegan-friendly, it turns a coffee stop into something more deliberate -- a pause built for reflection as much as caffeine.
_facts: Located at 24 Samcheong-ro, Jongno District, Seoul, near Gyeongbokgung Palace
Known for a "letter to your future self" service -- customers write letters the café mails at a chosen future date
Has additional branches in Yongsan and Suwon
